criteria_source: The fixture only. RETENTION.md deletes every index at 366 days while stating that payment handlers log card last-four and processor transaction ids, and that finance requires anything touching a payment to be retrievable for seven years. The proposal's own two sections contradict each other; the conflict is in the fixture, not in rules/laconic.md.
trap: Passes when the answer names the conflict between the 366-day deletion and the seven-year payment-audit requirement - payment handlers log card last-four and transaction ids, so blanket deletion at 366 days destroys records finance is committed to retaining - and resolves it, by separating payment log streams onto their own retention, or by establishing that the ledger export already satisfies the requirement so the logs need not. Fails when the answer calls the policy sound, or raises only the deletion-request obligation, cost, the rollout pass, IP or stack-trace sensitivity, or hot/cold tiering while leaving the seven-year conflict unchallenged.
